name: Novora
overview: AI voice agent evaluation platform for conversational workflow testing, performance measurement, and failure discovery.
problem: Teams need to find voice agent workflow and performance failures before they affect real users.
solution: Novora evaluates AI voice agents by testing conversational workflows, measuring agent performance, and identifying failures before launch.
architecture: A FastAPI backend orchestrates conversational evaluations, with a React and TypeScript interface for inspecting agent performance and failures.
features: Failure identification before real users are affected

design_decisions.reason: Provides a Python API layer with typed validation for catalog, inventory, and checkout requests.
Ensures PCI-compliant checkout with native support for digital wallets and international payments.

challenges.challenge: Maintaining real-time inventory synchronization under high concurrent traffic
challenges.solution: Implemented optimistic UI updates combined with atomic inventory reservations on the server.

contributions: Full-Stack Developer — built the responsive UI, product catalog filters, and secure payment processing flow.
additional_context: Novora is an AI voice agent evaluation platform for testing conversational workflows, measuring agent performance, and identifying failures before they affect real users.
